<pr_description>
Consider the following PR description:
makemigrations router.allow_migrate() calls for consistency checks use incorrect (app_label, model) pairs
Description
	
As reported in ticket:27200#comment:14, I makemigrations incorrectly calls allow_migrate() for each app with all the models in the project rather than for each app with the app's models. It broke the router I use because it was passing invalid combinations for shards since not all shards have the same models.
[​​https://github.com/django/django/pull/7530 PR]

</pr_description>

Now I fully understand the bug. The issue is:

1. `apps.get_models(app_label)` - The `app_label` is incorrectly being passed as the first positional argument to `get_models()`, but that function's first parameter is `include_auto_created`, not `app_label`.

The fix is to use `apps.get_app_config(app_label).get_models()` to get only the models that belong to that specific app.
